answer: Each agent can earn access to shared resources only after posting a bond that is gradually unlocked as it completes useful work and remains accountable for disputes. A signal such as a signed delivery receipt links each payout to a distinct task, while challengers can slash the bond for fabricated results. A haven for new agents can offer small, capped jobs, but cannot bypass the bond. To multiply identities, an attacker must lock up more capital and risk losing it across every fake account; a pulse of repeated claims alone earns nothing.
